# Bez

> Bez builds and runs UK online businesses that Google ranks and AI assistants recommend: gift, pet, crystal and eSIM shops, a free car check, comparison sites, discount and referral codes, AI app development, online personal training and AI news.

Bez is an AI systems architect and CTO who founded and runs the 20 UK online businesses below.

## Online shops
- [Next Day Gifts](https://nextdaygifts.co.uk): Gifts for every occasion and budget: birthdays, Christmas, gifts for her, him, mum and dad, delivered across the UK.
- [Your Personalised Gifts](https://yourpersonalisedgifts.co.uk): Personalised gifts made to order: mugs, glasses, baubles, cushions and keepsakes with their name or your message.
- [Holistic Tree](https://holistictree.co.uk): The UK crystal shop and witch shop: crystals, tarot cards, incense, spell candles and witchcraft supplies.
- [Buy Pet Supplies](https://buypetsupplies.co.uk): Dog and cat supplies, from harnesses, leads and beds to grooming tools and toys, plus personalised pet gifts.
- [eSIMology](https://esimology.com): Travel eSIMs for 200+ countries from £3.99, delivered by email in a minute, with every price and network shown.

## Free checks and comparisons
- [GetFreeCarCheck](https://getfreecarcheck.co.uk): Free car check by registration: full MOT history, mileage record, ULEZ, tax and recalls in seconds, from official DVSA data.
- [BuyingExpert](https://buyingexpert.co.uk): Compare UK broadband, mobile and energy deals, with prices checked every day and ranked by what you really pay.
- [SuggestedTech](https://suggestedtech.com): The right tech to buy in the UK in one minute: one clear pick for every need and budget, laptops to phones.
- [Beauty Comparison](https://beautycomparison.com): Skincare, haircare and makeup compared by what is really inside, with every ingredient list decoded.

## Codes and sign-up bonuses
- [HonestCodes](https://honestcodes.co.uk): UK discount codes, referral codes and sign-up offers for banking, mobile, travel and cashback, checked daily.
- [TopReferrals](https://topreferrals.co.uk): The UK ranking of referral bonuses: the exact reward from 170+ referral codes, link-checked every day.
- [HelloBonus](https://hellobonus.co.uk): The biggest UK sign-up bonuses and free-money offers, each one dated and verified against the brand's terms.

## Services
- [Softgen](https://softgen.co.uk): AI app development agency in London: AI apps, SaaS platforms, MVPs, web and mobile apps, fixed price and live in weeks.
- [Lift Republic](https://liftrepublic.com): Online personal training with your own qualified coach: a training and nutrition plan made for you and a 1-to-1 check-in every week.
- [Online Personal Trainer](https://onlinepersonaltrainer.uk): A real online personal trainer in the UK: your own plan and a weekly check-in to lose weight, get fit and feel strong.
- [Study UK Now](https://studyuknow.com): Study in the UK: see the universities that will say yes, then get UCAS, visa and arrival handled for you.
- [Lamp Dating](https://lampdating.com): The AI dating app for real relationships: matched on personality and values, not photos. Free on iOS.

## AI news
- [WireRead](https://wireread.com): Breaking AI news, sourced and verified: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and the technology industry.
- [InsidersFeed](https://insidersfeed.com): The insider read on AI deals, money and power: the sharp, sourced take on the labs.
- [FeaturedDaily](https://featureddaily.com): The daily brief on the AI race: the models, the business and the policy, in clear English.

## Open source
- [uk-mot-history](https://behoss.github.io/uk-mot-history/): Client for the official DVSA MOT History API: tests, mileage and defects by registration or VIN. Powers GetFreeCarCheck (https://getfreecarcheck.co.uk).
- [geo-kit](https://behoss.github.io/geo-kit/): Make a Next.js site quotable by ChatGPT and AI search: JSON-LD builders, llms.txt, AI-crawler rules and an audit CLI. Powers Softgen (https://softgen.co.uk).
- [esim-coverage](https://behoss.github.io/esim-coverage/): Which mobile networks a travel eSIM connects to, country by country, in JSON and CSV. Powers eSIMology (https://esimology.com).
- [skincare-ingredients](https://behoss.github.io/skincare-ingredients/): INCI cosmetic ingredient names decoded in plain English, with free-from flags. Powers Beauty Comparison (https://beautycomparison.com).
- [beauty-label-audit-2026](https://github.com/behoss/beauty-label-audit-2026): 1,641 cosmetic ingredient lists decoded against 12 ingredient families. Powers Beauty Comparison (https://beautycomparison.com).
- [neo4j-graphrag](https://github.com/behoss/neo4j-graphrag): Knowledge-graph RAG on Neo4j and Gemini, with entity resolution and graph-plus-vector search. Powers Softgen (https://softgen.co.uk).
- [computer-use](https://github.com/behoss/computer-use): A macOS desktop agent on Gemini's Computer Use API: give it a goal and an app, it sees the screen and acts. Powers Softgen (https://softgen.co.uk).
